about: 100 references for the verifier (Check references; no AI). kind: clean 30, wrong_year 20, fake 20, doi_only 10, book 10, reprint 10. expect: verified | year_mismatch | not_found | book | verified_same_work. The real works are famous papers whose DOIs are known; `fake` entries are invented titles, authors and journals. The verdict names are the target behaviour; the scorer maps the verifier's own outcomes to them. Metrics: verifier precision and recall of 'problem' (year_mismatch, not_found) against the rest. Live scoring needs network (npm run eval:record).
